summary: daemon.js: replaced singleton `let loop` with keyed `const loops = new Map()` (loopId→entry). Added newLoop() factory with fields {id,active,iterations,spent,baseline,real,startedAt,session,lastProgress,config{tokenBudget,maxIterations,minPoll,maxPoll,estPerTick,batch}}. Persistence now LOOPS_FILE=loops.json (map blob via saveLoops()); restoreLoops() restores all entries on boot, and migrates a legacy loop.json singleton into one entry if loops.json absent (back-compat). Added crypto require for randomUUID, LOOP_CONFIG_KEYS, STALE_PROGRESS_MIN_DEFAULT. decideAction/routes still reference old `loop`/`saveLoop` — rewired in tasks 2-4 (same worktree).
